title: Black Files Series Hub
mission: Make Matrix Reprogrammed feel like a living exposé archive: deep case files, source routes, missing records, institution lanes, money lanes, and next pulls.
boundary: The Black Files hub presents public-record investigations. It separates confirmed records, alleged lanes, open questions, missing records and rejected/blocked material. No private victim identifiers, explicit content, private addresses, family/minor data, live movement data or unsupported guilt claims.

frontDoorSections.title: Start Here
frontDoorSections.body: Read The Epstein Files: The Protection Network first. It explains the mission, evidence ladder, confirmed records, open questions and missing files.

frontDoorSections.title: Then Follow The Money
frontDoorSections.body: Open the Banking & Compliance lane and Tracker Core money routes. Banking and settlement claims require file-level court records, not vibes.

frontDoorSections.title: Then Track The Power Class
frontDoorSections.body: Open the Billionaire Power Map. Every person is treated as a tracked object, not a verdict. The next job is to attach independent filings, public responses and verified records.

frontDoorSections.title: Then Pressure The Release Machine
frontDoorSections.body: Open The Release Machine and Missing Files board. A huge release can still hide truth through redaction, gating, bad search, fake submissions and unclassified material.
